pdms_silicone.finding: All four SAFFIRE-II silicone coupons ignited but none sustained propagation; silica-ash layer implicated in extinction
pdms_silicone.cite: SAFFIRE-II review (GRAVIFIRE_SAFFIRE-II_PSI-99_Deep_Research.md) SS16.1 + SS5.2; Niehaus 2015; Rojas-Alva 2022

sibal_saffire2.finding: SIBAL fabric spread over the full 29 cm sample in microgravity at both tested concurrent flows (S5 ~2.1, S6 ~2.6 mm/s published), bridging small-scale BASS results
sibal_saffire2.quote: S5/S6 complete burns; scale bridge established

pmma_thick.finding: Thick PMMA (S8 2mm-profile, S9 1 cm) did not spread; flames anchored at the base with slow regression 0.01-0.04 mm/s
pmma_thick.quote: anchored at base, regression not spread

pmma_nomex.finding: PMMA ignition aid fully consumed but adjacent Nomex did not ignite
pmma_nomex.quote: PMMA portion completely consumed, Nomex not ignited
pmma_nomex.cite: SAFFIRE-II review SS5.2 + table note 2; Thomsen 2019

sibal_bass.finding: BASS SIBAL opposed-flow spread was not simply monotonic with airflow; low-flow quenching directly observed

sibal_bass2.finding: BASS-II SIBAL showed concurrent growth and spread with low-flow quenching at the weakest flows

thin_pmma_film.finding: Thin PMMA films exhibit radiative/thermal/kinetic spread regimes with radiative extinction at very low flow

pmma_rod.finding: PMMA rods show a quench-vs-blowoff boundary organized by Damkohler number

pmma_sphere.finding: Thermal history changes thick spherical PMMA burn outcome in microgravity
pmma_sphere.quote: thermal-history effects on thick spherical fuel

bass_suppression.finding: Nitrogen jet intended to suppress could entrain ambient air and enhance combustion instead
bass_suppression.quote: suppression jet entrained air, enhanced combustion

saffire1_s1.finding: The large SAFFIRE-I SIBAL flame reached a quasi-steady state over the 420 s burn, unlike upward 1-g spread
saffire1_s1.quote: quasi-steady large flame; differs from 1g upward spread

saffire1_s2.finding: SAFFIRE-I Sample 2 (opposed flow) burned only ~70 s before extinction - shorter than the concurrent S1
saffire1_s2.cite: SAFFIRE-I review SS10.3; PSI-98 table as-flown burn time

candle_wax.finding: Paraffin/Japan-wax candles showed weak persistent flames at very low flow and the suppression jet could enhance them
candle_wax.quote: weak persistent candle flames; suppression complications
